description: List the available skills (tool groups) — project, documents, search, analysis, compilation, memory, relationships — with a description, the tool count, whether the skill is already active, and its tool names. Use this to discover capabilities, then call use_skill to activate a group whose tools you need. Takes no parameters.
name: list_skills

activated.description: Whether the skill is already active this session.

tool_names.description: Names of the visible tools in the skill.

tools.description: Number of visible tools in the skill.

title: List Skills
